title: How Many Apples Can You Put into the Basket
description:
You have some apples and a basket that can carry up to 5000 units of weight. 
 
 Given an integer array weight where weight[i] is the weight of the i th apple, return the maximum number of apples you can put in the basket . 

 Example 1: 
 
```
Input:
 weight = [100,200,150,1000]

Output:
 4

Explanation:
 All 4 apples can be carried by the basket since their sum of weights is 1450.
```

 Example 2: 
 
```
Input:
 weight = [900,950,800,1000,700,800]

Output:
 5

Explanation:
 The sum of weights of the 6 apples exceeds 5000 so we choose any 5 of them.
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= weight.length <= 10 3 
 
 1 <= weight[i] <= 10 3
